title.romaji: Yuusha Kei ni Shosu: Choubatsu Yuusha 9004-tai Keimu Kiroku
title.native: 勇者刑に処す 懲罰勇者9004隊刑務記録

synonyms: ผู้กล้าโทษประหาร : บันทึกการรับโทษของหน่วยผู้กล้าต้องโทษ 9004
description:
In a world where heroism is a punishment, Xylo Forbartz, a condemned goddess killer, battles endless hordes of monstrous abominations as part of Penal Hero Unit 9004. Death is no escape, only a cycle of resurrection and relentless combat. But when Xylo encounters a mysterious new goddess, their unlikely alliance sparks a rebellion that could shatter the chains of eternal punishment.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Notes:
- The first episode aired with a runtime of ~58 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
- Initially scheduled to air in October, 2025

name.native: ザイロ・フォルバーツ

node.description: The former captain of the Federated Kingdom's Fifth Order of the Holy Knights and the now de facto leader of Penal Hero Unit 9004. He was sentenced to be a hero for the crime of killing the goddess [Senerva](https://anilist.co/character/387992/Senerva). He would later meet and reluctantly make a contract with [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726), the "Goddess of Swords".

The Sword Goddess who made a contract with [Xylo](https://anilist.co/character/355722/Xylo-Forbartz). She summons numerous swords, including holy swords and demon swords. While possessing a high sense of self-worth and a fondness for being praised, she also exhibits a characteristic goddess-like trait of engaging in self-sacrificing actions.

name.native: ベネティム・レオプール

node.description: The commander of the Punisher Heroes Squad 9004. He is a rare conman who attempted to sell off the royal palace to a circus. His eloquence and deception skills make him appear competent at first glance, but in reality he's a weakling with no guts. He always delivers "bad news" in a hurry.

name.native: パトーシェ・キヴィア

node.description: Captain of the 13th Holy Knights. She was originally supposed to make a pact with the Goddess [Teoritta](https://anilist.co/character/355726/Teoritta). She is a serious and righteous holy knight, but can also be strict and harsh in her words. She is willing to sacrifice her own life and the life of the hero for the Goddess.

An unparalleled petty thief, responsible for over a thousand thefts. He impulsively attempts to steal anything, from the Goddess's coffin to completely meaningless objects, and possesses the skill to actually steal anything. He has excellent low-light vision and is sensitive to presences, but is extremely timid.

A berserker who has been a member of the Hero Squad longer than anyone else. Because he has been resurrected as a hero so many times, he has lost his sense of self and the ability to think, and is unable to speak. His true identity and everything else about him are shrouded in mystery. His close combat abilities are monstrous, and he wields a giant battle axe as easily as a kitchen knife.

name.native: ノルガユ・センリッジ

node.description: A terrorist who believed himself to be the true king of the United Kingdom and carried out a large-scale terrorist act against the royal family. Nicknamed "His Majesty." Although he displays an arrogant attitude, his concern for his people is genuine. He possesses exceptional talent in the art of Sacred Seal Tuning, which engraves sacred symbols.

A former elite assassin raised by an assassination cult. He possesses supernatural-level sniping abilities, but during his time as an assassin, he would develop empathy for his targets, preventing him from killing them, and would instead turn innocent people into "mincemeat" to cover up his losses. He's easygoing and talkative, and loves gambling.

A female dragon who races alongside [Jayce](https://anilist.co/character/375408/Jayce-Patiract) on the battlefield. She possesses vibrant blue scales and can unleash powerful flames from her mouth. Because Jayce is loved by the dragon, she can sometimes become jealous and upset. According to Jayce, her dark eyes and strong will are her charms.

name.native: ジェイス・パーチラクト

node.description: A dragoon who rides a dragon and soars through the skies as the unit's aerial force. He is also skilled in spearmanship. Not only can he communicate with dragons, but he also has an abnormally endearing disposition. He himself is only interested in dragons and is unfriendly towards humans.

An eccentric who volunteered to become a Hero, he possesses a talent for artillery. He has a polite demeanor and speaks like a saint, but he always wears a suspicious smile. His bizarre armor encases his entire body, engraved with holy symbols, and his enormous right arm functions as a cannon barrel.


~! He is actually a Demon Blight, Puck Puca, whom enjoys killing their own kind. !~

name.native: フレンシィ・マスティボルト

node.description: The daughter of the Mastibolt family, the leader of the Southern Night Demons. Formerly engaged to [Xylo](https://anilist.co/character/355722/Xylo-Forbartz), their engagement was annulled when he became a Hero, but she refuses to acknowledge that she broke off her engagement with him. Her expression remains unchanged as she utters harsh words.

name.native: ゾフレク・オストビシュ
シムリード・コルマディノ
カフゼン・ダクローム

node.description: Captain of the 12th Order of the Holy Knights.

name.native: ホード・クリヴィオス

node.description: She is known as the Goddess of Poisons.

name.native: セオドニー・ナンティア

node.description: She is known as the Goddess of Knowledge.

She is known as the Goddess of Fortresses, able to summon structures from other worlds, and was once the contracted goddess of [Xylo Forbartz](https://anilist.co/character/355722), the former captain of the Fifth Order of the Holy Knights.
She is known as the Goddess of Shadows.
